text:
amelia: Thanks for the great All-Hands today. Dropping a follow-up thread specifically for folks who asked about billing patterns, demo quotas, and how credits interplay with rate limits. We'll log answers here and tag owners.

max: quick clarification 52525252 do developer sandbox accounts get the same rate limits as paid hosted keys?

raj: sandbox keys use a stricter default to protect shared infra: 20 rps and 4 concurrent requests. They also have a smaller monthly token allotment (10k tokens) and no burst window. If a customer upgrades their org, limits migrate to the org's paid defaults.

claire: is there a transparent mapping between "token allotment" and credits? customers asked for "how many credits per 1M tokens" math in the console.

leo: good ask. Pricing varies by model (we have several tiers). We already show effective cost-per-token on the Billing page next to each model used in the period. We'll add a small calculator widget ("estimate tokens from credits") to the page. ETA: end of May.

natalie: for demos, sales want a short-lived demo key that allows higher concurrency for 1-2 hours. What's the fastest path?

olivia: process: file a support request with subject "demo-boost" + list of keys and windows. Ops will provision a temporary policy with elevated concurrency and a capped hourly spend. Note: we do require SSO + demo TOS signed for bursts > 200 rps.

max: can demo boosts be auto-approved for internal SE accounts?

raj: internal SE accounts have an internal allowlist and can request via the internal tool; typically auto-approved up to 120 rps for 2 hours. Anything above that needs Ops review.

amelia: another question from legal: can credits be applied retroactively to a billing period if a customer disputes usage?

leo: we handle disputes case-by-case. Credits can be issued retroactively as a one-time adjustment (billing credit) but we don't rewrite historical invoices. The customer will see a separate credit line item in the next invoice.

claire: about rate limit behavior 525252 what should client libraries do on 429? immediate retry, exponential backoff, or drop?

raj: recommended behavior: exponential backoff with jitter; honor Retry-After when present. For streaming requests, we recommend a fallback to a smaller batch size / reduce parallel workers. We'll add a snippet to the SDK docs. Example: ```const backoff = ms => Math.min(10000, ms * 2 + Math.random()*100);
// on 429: wait Retry-After || backoff(prev)
```

natalie: can we get webhook alerts to notify when an org spends 75% of committed monthly credits?

leo: yes. We'll ship webhook/email alerts at 50/75/95% for committed plans. For hosted pay-as-you-go we will provide an estimate alert at a configurable monthly spend threshold.

olivia: question: do credits expire differently for promotional vs trial credits? we need this spelled out for sales decks.

leo: promo credits often have shorter expiry windows (30/60 days) depending on campaign terms. Trial credits are standard 90 days. We'll add exact expiry metadata to the credits object in the API so frontends and emails can show it.

max: is there an API to list active promo codes and remaining balances for an org?

raj: yes, internal API exists: GET /v1/orgs/:id/credits -> returns list of credit entries (type, amount, expiry, usable). Public docs coming. ETA: Q3.

claire: last one 525252 can customers consume credits to pay for Dedicated reserved hours if they have an overlapping hosted balance? mixing modes causes confusion in accounting.

leo: by default, reserved Dedicated plans are invoiced against contract terms not against hosted credits. However, for some customers we support applying hosted credits as a one-off offset after negotiation. That's an accounting exception and requires finance sign-off. We'll document this for sales.

deploy-bot: Billing-runner: new "credit-expiry-notice" email will be enabled next rollout (2026-06-02) to 10% orgs.

amelia: action items: raj -> publish sandbox vs paid limit table & SDK retry guidance (ETA 2w); leo -> add credits calculator + promo expiry table to Billing UI backlog; olivia -> make a demo-boost SOP for SEs and update internal wiki. natalie -> consolidate top 10 customer billing FAQs and we'll prioritize comms.

natalie: will ping folks and gather questions from sales/SEs. thanks all :rocket:

leo: thanks team. we'll update the internal KB when items land.

amelia: closing thread for now; reopen if more Qs.
